create_CustomFunction: create a CustomFunction experiment function with a configurable offset parameter for benchmarking
test_CustomFunction_oracle_call: test the CustomFunction oracle_call method which computes squared distance from an offset
build_NewOptimizer: build a NewOptimizer by extending NoisyBandit and registering it in the optimizer registry
run_additional_experiment: run the additional_experiment generator yielding Experiment plans with CustomFunction and sphere functions
review_experiment_plan: review the additional_experiment plan that tests NewOptimizer and RandomSearch across budgets of 10 and 100
